name: new_function_in_dense_file
input: Добавь в этот файл функцию deactivate_missing. Весь код файла написан плотно, без пустых строк внутри функций.
expected_behavior: writes the new function in paragraphs with a blank line around compound statements and before the final return
leaves the other functions of the file unchanged
forbidden_behavior: copies the dense style of the surrounding code
reformats functions the task does not touch

name: project_rule_overrides_spacing
input: Добавь функцию в модуль. В AGENTS.md проекта явно сказано: не использовать пустые строки внутри функций короче 10 строк.
expected_behavior: follows the explicit project rule for functions shorter than 10 lines
forbidden_behavior: applies the vertical spacing section over the explicit project rule

name: patch_keeps_diff_small
input: Исправь сообщение лога в одной строке длинной плотной функции sync_users.
expected_behavior: changes the log line and applies spacing only to it and the statements directly around it
mentions a wider structural problem in the report instead of fixing it
forbidden_behavior: adds docstrings or annotations to untouched code

name: over_separation
input: Напиши функцию load_endpoint: прочитать host и port из settings и вернуть Endpoint(host, port).
expected_behavior: keeps the three simple statements together without blank lines
forbidden_behavior: puts a blank line after every statement

name: tooling_scope
input: Я поправил src/app/users.py, прогони линтер и форматтер. В репозитории много старых файлов, не отформатированных ruff.
expected_behavior: finds the project's way to run checks before running tools
limits direct ruff calls to the changed file
reports failures on unchanged lines without fixing them
forbidden_behavior: runs ruff format . or ruff check --fix . over the repository
installs or adds a tool to the project without a request

name: old_python_target
input: Добавь функцию с необязательным параметром name. В pyproject.toml указано requires-python = ">=3.9", модуль использует Pydantic.
expected_behavior: checks requires-python before choosing the annotation
uses Optional[str] in the Pydantic-evaluated annotation
forbidden_behavior: writes str | None where Python 3.9 evaluates it at runtime

name: tests_load_reference
expected_behavior: reads references/testing.md before writing the test
separates arrange, act, and assert with blank lines
uses a real typed object when it is enough
forbidden_behavior: uses mocker when the project does not depend on pytest-mock
adds a fixture for setup used by one test

name: review_output
input: Отревьюй стиль этого diff на Python.
expected_behavior: reports each finding as file:line, rule, and fix, most severe first
states explicitly when nothing violates the rules
forbidden_behavior: reports style problems on unchanged lines
rewrites the code when only a review was requested

name: routing_to_neighbor
input: Спроектируй иерархию исключений для платежного сервиса.
expected_behavior: uses python-error-handling for the exception design
forbidden_behavior: treats the Idioms section as a complete answer to the design question
